description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans activation repartitioning, focusing on default tolerance scenarios, grain movement, placement decisions, and stream-based receiver movement. It defines test classes, grain interfaces, grain implementations, and test fixture setup.

classes.name: DefaultToleranceTests
classes.description: Unit test class for Orleans activation repartitioning default tolerance scenarios, including grain movement and placement logic.

classes.name: GrainBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for grains providing common functionality like getting the grain's address.

classes.name: A
classes.description: Grain implementation for scenario A, handling initial pings and orchestrating grain movements based on scenarios.

classes.name: B
classes.description: Grain implementation for scenario B, responding to pings with behavior depending on the scenario.

classes.name: C
classes.description: Grain implementation for scenario C, capable of pinging and moving to specific silos based on scenario.

classes.name: CImmovable
classes.description: Immovable grain class representing a grain that should stay on a specific silo during repartitioning.

classes.name: D
classes.description: Grain implementation for scenario D, with specific ping behavior.

classes.name: SP
classes.description: Streaming producer grain that pushes messages to a stream, marked as immovable.

classes.name: SR
classes.description: Streaming consumer grain that subscribes to a stream and records if it received any messages.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Test fixture setting up the Orleans test cluster with specific options and stream configuration.

methods.name: FirstPing
methods.description: Initial ping method to set up the scenario, including grain placement hints.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Method to perform a ping operation within a scenario.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when a grain is activated, used here to set up streams.

methods.name: GetAddress
methods.description: Method to retrieve the silo address where the grain is located.
